autoUpdate.desc: Runs steamcmd app_update 730 before every start. An outdated server rejects clients.

defaultMap.desc: Map loaded on start when no Workshop collection is set.

gameMode.desc: game_type 0: 0 = Casual, 1 = Competitive, 2 = Wingman | game_type 1: 0 = Arms Race, 2 = Deathmatch | game_type 3: 0 = Custom

gameType.desc: 0 = Classic, 1 = Gun Game / Deathmatch, 3 = Custom (rules in game/csgo/cfg/gamemode_custom_server.cfg)

gslt.desc: Game Server Login Token (steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers, App ID 730). Without it the server is not publicly reachable.

hostname.desc: hostname shown in the server browser. No double quotes.

ip.desc: Host IP address the server listens on (Docker port binding). 0.0.0.0 = all interfaces.

mapGroup.desc: +mapgroup, e.g. mg_active, mg_deathmatch, mg_armsrace. The default map must be part of this group. Empty = not used. Ignored when a Workshop collection is set.

metamod.desc: Adds the csgo/addons/metamod path to gameinfo.gi on every start. Upload Metamod (and CounterStrikeSharp) to game/csgo/addons manually.

rconPassword.desc: rcon_password. CS2 has no built-in admin account, administration is done via RCON. No double quotes.

serverPassword.desc: sv_password. Empty = no password. No double quotes.

workshopCollection.desc: Steam Workshop map collection ID (host_workshop_collection). When set, the default map is ignored.

pre.text:
#!/bin/bash
cd /pufferpanel
export HOME=/pufferpanel
# libserver.so (game/csgo/bin) needs libv8*.so from game/bin -> add both to the library path
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/pufferpanel/game/bin/linuxsteamrt64:/pufferpanel/game/csgo/bin/linuxsteamrt64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"

# steamclient.so must be in ~/.steam/sdk64 (otherwise "Failed to load steamclient.so")
# Source: Steamworks SDK Redist (app 1007) in persistent /pufferpanel/steamworks
SDK=/pufferpanel/.steam/sdk64
SW=/pufferpanel/steamworks/linux64/steamclient.so
if [ ! -f "$SW" ]; then
  echo "[pufferpanel] Downloading Steamworks SDK Redist (app 1007)..."
  steamcmd +force_install_dir /pufferpanel/steamworks +login anonymous +app_update 1007 +quit
fi
if [ -f "$SW" ]; then
  [ -L "$SDK" ] && rm -f "$SDK"
  mkdir -p "$SDK"
  cp -f "$SW" "$SDK/steamclient.so"
else
  echo "[pufferpanel] ERROR: $SW is missing, the server will not start"
fi

# Metamod: game updates overwrite gameinfo.gi, so it is patched on every start
GI=/pufferpanel/game/csgo/gameinfo.gi
if [ "${metamod}" = "true" ] && [ -f "$GI" ] && ! grep -q 'csgo/addons/metamod' "$GI"; then
  sed -i 's|^\(\s*\)Game_LowViolence\(\s*\)csgo_lv.*$|&\n\1Game\2csgo/addons/metamod|' "$GI"
fi

# server.cfg runs on every map load -> append an exec of our cfg
CFG=/pufferpanel/game/csgo/cfg/server.cfg
touch "$CFG"
grep -q '^exec pufferpanel' "$CFG" || printf '\nexec pufferpanel\n' >> "$CFG"

set -- -dedicated -usercon -port ${port} -maxplayers ${maxPlayers} +game_type ${gameType} +game_mode ${gameMode} +exec pufferpanel.cfg
if [ -n "${gslt}" ]; then
  set -- "$@" +sv_setsteamaccount "${gslt}"
fi
if [ -n "${workshopCollection}" ]; then
  set -- "$@" +host_workshop_collection "${workshopCollection}"
else
  if [ -n "${mapGroup}" ]; then
    set -- "$@" +mapgroup "${mapGroup}"
  fi
  set -- "$@" +map "${defaultMap}"
fi

exec ./game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/cs2 "$@"
